keyword.en: how to inquire Xingtai for High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine
keyword.zh: 如何向邢台询盘大流量液压混凝土喷涂机

title.en: Ask Xingtai to price the High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine only after the inquiry names output, distance, power and particle size
title.zh: 向邢台询大流量液压混凝土喷涂机的价格前，先写清输送量、距离、动力和粒径

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine at /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine. Copy only the printed cells: Model High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine; Power Supply 380 V; Motor Power 11/15 kW; Drive Hydraulic control; dual motor (all coppe
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把大流量液压混凝土喷涂机列在 /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine。只抄已印格子：型号 High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine; 电源 380V; 电机功率 11/15 kW; 驱动 液压控制；全铜双电机; 理论输送量 7 m³/h; 最大出口压力 8 MPa; 输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 70 m; 管径 38/51 mm; 最大粒径 ≤8 mm; 砂灰比 ≤1:3; 适用材料 水泥砂浆、混凝土、灌浆料; 外形尺寸 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm; 整机重量 650

h1.en: The High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine inquiry starts from the printed page
h1.zh: 大流量液压混凝土喷涂机的询盘从已印页面开始

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine at /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine. Copy only the printed cells: Model High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine; Power Supply 380 V; Motor Power 11/15 kW; Drive Hydraulic control; dual motor (all copper); Output Capacity 7 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 8 MPa; Delivery Distance (H / V) 150 m / 70 m; Hose Diameter 38/51 mm; Max. Particle Size ≤8 mm; Sand-Cement Ratio ≤1:3; Applicable Materials Cement mortar, concrete, grout; Dimensions (L×W×H) 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm; Main Unit Weight 650 kg. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm and Main Unit Weight is 650 kg. The printed output cell is 7 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Delivery Distance (H / V) 150 m / 70 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. The printed power cell is 380 V. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. The printed aggregate or particle cell is ≤8 mm. Send the maximum stone or particle size in the mix. If the mix is coarser, this row is the wrong page. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai. The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cold_planer. It shows: [ 1 ] Asphalt paving being milled in preparation for repaving. It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把大流量液压混凝土喷涂机列在 /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine。只抄已印格子：型号 High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine; 电源 380V; 电机功率 11/15 kW; 驱动 液压控制；全铜双电机; 理论输送量 7 m³/h; 最大出口压力 8 MPa; 输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 70 m; 管径 38/51 mm; 最大粒径 ≤8 mm; 砂灰比 ≤1:3; 适用材料 水泥砂浆、混凝土、灌浆料; 外形尺寸 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm; 整机重量 650 kg。运输请抄外形尺寸是 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm，整机重量是 650 kg。已印输送量是 7 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 70 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。已印动力是 380 V。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。已印骨料或粒径是 ≤8 mm。询盘写混合物里的最大石子或粒径。料更粗时，这一行就不是该打开的页面。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。这篇配图是 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cold_planer 页面里的内容图片。画面主体：为重新铺装而铣刨沥青路面。它只作询盘主题的参考。它不是河北品锦机械的铭牌，不是报价单，也不是出口案例。

body.en: Put /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine in the subject. The published cells are: Model High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine; Power Supply 380 V; Motor Power 11/15 kW; Drive Hydraulic control; dual motor (all copper); Output Capacity 7 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 8 MPa; Delivery Distance (H / V) 150 m / 70 m; Hose Diameter 38/51 mm; Max. Particle Size ≤8 mm; Sand-Cement Ratio ≤1:3; Applicable Materials Cement mortar, concrete, grout; Dimensions (L×W×H) 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm; Main Unit Weight 650 kg. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine。已公布的格子是：型号 High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine; 电源 380V; 电机功率 11/15 kW; 驱动 液压控制；全铜双电机; 理论输送量 7 m³/h; 最大出口压力 8 MPa; 输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 70 m; 管径 38/51 mm; 最大粒径 ≤8 mm; 砂灰比 ≤1:3; 适用材料 水泥砂浆、混凝土、灌浆料; 外形尺寸 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm; 整机重量 650 kg。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Output, distance, power and particle size
heading.zh: 输送量、距离、动力和粒径

body.en: The printed output cell is 7 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Delivery Distance (H / V) 150 m / 70 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. The printed power cell is 380 V. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. The printed aggregate or particle cell is ≤8 mm. Send the maximum stone or particle size in the mix. If the mix is coarser, this row is the wrong page.
body.zh: 已印输送量是 7 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 70 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。已印动力是 380 V。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。已印骨料或粒径是 ≤8 mm。询盘写混合物里的最大石子或粒径。料更粗时，这一行就不是该打开的页面。

heading.en: What to ask Xingtai instead of guessing
heading.zh: 该问邢台，而不是自己猜

body.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. Also send country and purchase timing as facts about your order. Do not turn them into a promised lead time or an export-country list. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
body.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。同时把国家和采购时间作为订单事实发来。不要把它们写成承诺交期，也不要写成出口国名单。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

question.en: Is a price printed for the High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine?
question.zh: 大流量液压混凝土喷涂机印了价格吗？

answer.en: No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
answer.zh: 产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。
